summary: Foundational doctrine of the 14-ADR keystone is logically coherent and the Tier-1 lockdown ADRs correctly compose on top of it, but multiple cross-ADR references carry incorrect ADR-number / keystone-position pairings. The Foundry-dissolution authority chain in particular has at least three distinct, mutually-incompatible attributions across the bundle. This is a P1 correctness defect: each individual ADR's internal logic survives, but a reader/CI lane following the references would converge on an inconsistent doctrine. Recommend WARN with mandatory fixes before merge.

cross_adr_inconsistencies.description: Foundry-dissolution authority chain is mis-attributed across the bundle. ADR-0247 is the actual Foundry-dissolution owner (it supersedes ADR-0136 + ADR-0136-amendment, amends ADR-0137 + ADR-0138, and explicitly declares the six-BC redistribution). However, ADR-0255 refers 6+ times to 'ADR-0249 Foundry dissolution, keystone #13'. ADR-0249 is in fact the Multi-Category Marketplace Doctrine (keystone #8), per its own file's frontmatter and Purpose.

ADR-0251 §References block (lines 2024-2030) labels seven keystones with descriptions that DO NOT match the actual ADR contents: ADR-0249 labeled 'DR substrate doctrine', ADR-0250 labeled 'Data residency + jurisdiction model', ADR-0252 labeled 'Identity + authentication substrate', ADR-0253 labeled 'Audit chain substrate doctrine', ADR-0254 labeled 'Observability substrate doctrine'. None of these labels match the actual ADRs (which are Marketplace, Build-Ahead-of-Cert, Time-Coordination, Network-Topology, and Deployment-Model-Spectrum respectively).

ADR-0254 §References block (lines 1891-1910) and ADR-0255 §References block (lines 1877-1884) carry DIFFERENT incorrect labels for the same ADRs. ADR-0254 labels ADR-0249 'Per-tenant data residency spectrum'; ADR-0255 labels it 'Foundry dissolution'. Two different wrong labels means at most one (and in fact neither) is correct. Reviewer concludes the cross-reference blocks were populated by hand under a prior plan-of-record that was later reshuffled and never updated.

Keystone-position numbering is internally consistent within the frontmatter fields (ADR-0242=1, ADR-0243=2, ..., ADR-0255=14) but the prose cross-references in some ADRs claim positions inconsistent with the frontmatter. E.g., ADR-0255 says 'ADR-0249 (Foundry dissolution, keystone #13)' but ADR-0249's keystone_position frontmatter is 8-of-14, AND ADR-0254's keystone_position frontmatter is 13-of-14. This means the prose claim is inconsistent with two separate frontmatter facts.

ADR-0245 §Decision references 'ADR-0220 (Consumer Intelligence Substrate)' as conflating substrate-the-tier with substrate-the-rhetorical-weight-bearing-role. ADR-0255 then 'amends' (not supersedes) ADR-0220 and asserts ADR-0220 carries 'superseded_by: [ADR-0255]'. The relationship is: ADR-0255 partially supersedes ADR-0220's framing. This is logically consistent but requires that ADR-0220's frontmatter actually gain the superseded_by entry as ADR-0255 §Status claims. Reviewer did not verify ADR-0220's frontmatter; if it does not carry superseded_by:[ADR-0255], the claim is unverified.

ADR-0247 supersedes ADR-0136 + ADR-0136-amendment but only amends ADR-0239. ADR-0242 also amends ADR-0136-amendment and ADR-0239. There is no contradiction (both can amend), but the layering implies that ADR-0136-amendment is superseded by ADR-0247 while ADR-0239 is amended (not superseded) by both ADR-0242 and ADR-0247. Reviewer notes this is consistent but tightly coupled; a future reader reconstructing the supersession chain from ADR-0136 forward must traverse both ADR-0242 and ADR-0247.

ADR-0253 line 1466 calls ADR-0252 'Idempotency-keys canonical'. ADR-0252 is in fact 'Time, Coordination, and Distributed Consistency' which covers HLC + sagas + idempotency-keys + leap-second smear + per-cell cron jitter. Idempotency-keys is one of four primitives the ADR establishes, not the whole ADR. This is a mis-narrowing of a sister-ADR's scope.

recommendations: BEFORE MERGE: Sweep every '## References' / '## Cross-references' section in ADR-0249 through ADR-0255 and replace the keystone-position + ADR-title pairs with mechanically-derived values from each target ADR's actual frontmatter (id + purpose + keystone_position). This is a P1 fix; without it, downstream readers (human and CI lanes that parse keystone-position) will follow the wrong references.

Specifically in ADR-0255: replace all 6+ instances of 'ADR-0249 (Foundry dissolution, keystone #13)' with 'ADR-0247 (Self-hosting / self-modification, keystone #6)'. The BC-absorption logic of ADR-0255 §D-16 is correct; only the source-ADR attribution is wrong.

Add a CI lane (`oya gate validate keystone-cross-reference-coherence`) that parses each ADR's §References block and verifies every (ADR-id, keystone-position, brief-title) tuple resolves against the target ADR's frontmatter. This prevents recurrence of the systematic drift observed across ADR-0251/ADR-0254/ADR-0255 reference blocks.

In ADR-0253 line 1466 narrow-scope mis-labeling, replace 'ADR-0252 — Idempotency-keys canonical' with 'ADR-0252 — Time, coordination, and distributed consistency (idempotency-keys among 4 primitives)'.
Verify ADR-0220's frontmatter actually carries `superseded_by: [ADR-0255]` as ADR-0255 §Status claims. If not, the partial-supersession contract is incomplete.

The Tier-1 lockdown ADRs (ADR-0257, ADR-0258, ADR-0263, ADR-0272, ADR-0273, ADR-0276, ADR-0280, ADR-0284, ADR-0292, ADR-0255-amendment) are individually correctness-clean and their Decision sections derive correctly from their stated Contexts. F1 is GREEN for the Tier-1 subset.

The 14 foundational ADRs are individually correctness-clean within each ADR's body; F1 defects are concentrated in cross-ADR references, not in the doctrines themselves. The fundamental architecture (tenant-as-primitive + Cedar-universality + substrate-vs-product + cellular + compliance-packs + build-ahead) is mutually-reinforcing and logically valid.
